sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The gameplay mechanics in BrawlBall.io are simple yet addictive. The game uses a top-down perspective, where players control their avatars using the WASD keys to move and the mouse to aim and shoot. The objective is to score goals while preventing the opposing team from scoring. The game features a variety of game modes, including a standard 2v2 mode and a more challenging 1v1 mode.

One of the standout features of BrawlBall.io is its emphasis on teamwork. Players are randomly assigned to teams based on their trophy count, which adds a fun and unpredictable element to the game. However, players can also create their own teams and invite friends to play together, making it a great option for social gamers.

In terms of controls, BrawlBall.io is very responsive and easy to pick up. The WASD keys provide a smooth and intuitive way to move around the pitch, while the mouse allows for precise aiming and shooting. The click-to-shoot mechanic is also well-implemented, allowing players to quickly unleash a powerful shot or tackle an opponent. Overall, the gameplay mechanics in BrawlBall.io are solid and well-designed, making it easy to jump into the game and start playing.
